Name: Buildable - Greenhouse
Author: sexynes
Description:
Allows players to build a greenhouse. 

[size=5]Requirements [/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Vanilla Greenhouse has been unlocked. [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Access Robin's shop [/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Known Issues [/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Incompatible with these greenhouse mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18991]Legacy Greenhouse[/url]﻿ [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If you have Buildable Greenhouse v2, do not install v3 and avoid uninstalling v2. [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]If you uninstall this mod, destroy every Greenhouse and input the command into SMAPI (assuming you have ConsoleCommands mod that comes with SMAPI): [b]debug build Greenhouse 10 10[/b][/size][/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: If you have Buildable Greenhouse v2, do not install v3. If you do uninstall, check the Description page for more information.
